content_sections.heading: NIT Agartala Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NIT Agartala Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download NIT Agartala Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: NIT Agartala Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: JRF (Junior Research Fellow): Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate/Post Graduate in Professional Course selected through National Eligibility Tests – CSIR UGC NET/GATE or National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments. Preference for nanotechnology, nanomaterials fabrication experience. Project Associate-1: Four Years Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree in relevant domain or Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology. Preference for nanotechnology, nanomaterials fabrication experience.

content_sections.heading: NIT Agartala Recruitment 2026 - Salary/ Stipend
content_sections.text: JRF (Junior Research Fellow): Rs. 37000 (with 10% HRA) Per Month Project Associate-1: Rs. 30000 (with 10% HRA) Per Month

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 24-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Agartala recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the NIT Agartala recruitment is 24th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in the NIT Agartala recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts are JRF (Junior Research Fellow) and Project Associate-1.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply via Email for this recruitment process.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The salary for the JRF post is Rs. 37000 per month, including 10% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-1 post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Associate-1 post is Rs. 30000 per month, including 10% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NIT Agartala recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the interview date for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The interview for the shortlisted candidates will be conducted on 26th August 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website of NIT Agartala?
faq.answer: The official website of National Institute of Technology Agartala is www.nita.ac.in.

faq.question: Q9. What are the minimum qualifications required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: For the JRF post, a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science or a Graduate/Post Graduate in a Professional Course selected through NET/GATE is required.

faq.question: Q10. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Project Associate-1 post?
faq.answer: For the Project Associate-1 post, a Four Years Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree in a relevant domain or a Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology is required.
